parole.significato: fungi of genera Volvariella and Volvopluteus (family Pluteaceae)
parole.testo: Introduced into Czech by the botanist Jan Svatopluk Presl in 1846. Borrowed from Slovene kukmak (“Agaricus”), which comes from a German dialect expression Kuckenmucken (“Agaricus”).
Coined by Jan Svatopluk Presl, based on Slovene raca (“duck”).
